title: feat(app-shell): ADR-0040 — the agent picker leaves consumer UX
body:
objectui half of [ADR-0040](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/1734) (pairs with [framework#1735](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/1735), merged):

- `/ai` header: the agent roster no longer renders for end users — they see the resolved assistant's label. The dropdown appears only when an explicit `?agent=` pin is present (builder/developer deep links; Studio's `metadata_assistant` pin unchanged).
- Selection still happens — by **scenario** (`app.defaultAgent` → platform default), not by the user.

app-shell 409/409, build green.
